	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES entry_groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_state JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

saved_selections.sql:
CREATE TABLE saved_selections (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	atom_references JSON NOT NULL, 
	granularity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

scenes.sql:
CREATE TABLE scenes (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	camera JSON NOT NULL, 
	entry_states JSON NOT NULL, 
	selection JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

structure_entries.sql:
CREATE TABLE "structure_entries" (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	group_id VARCHAR(36), 
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	structure_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	original_filename VARCHAR(255), 
	source_format VARCHAR(32), 
	normalized_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	visible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	locked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	user_metadata JSON NOT NULL, 
	dirty BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	job_links JSON NOT NULL, 
	generated_results JSON NOT NULL, 
	original_artifact_id VARCHAR(36), 
	current_artifact_id VARCHAR(36), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	atom_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	bond_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	residue_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	conformer_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	viewer_settings JSON NOT NULL, 
	atom_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	next_atom_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_bond_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(current_artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES entry_groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

workspace_presentations.sql:
CREATE TABLE workspace_presentations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	camera JSON NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_presentation_singleton CHECK (id = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_presentation_schema CHECK (schema_version = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_presentation_revision CHECK (revision >= 1)
)

alembic_version.sql:
CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

artifacts.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	relative_path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (sha256), 
	UNIQUE (relative_path)
)

command_records.sql:
CREATE TABLE command_records (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	command_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	forward_actions JSON NOT NULL, 
	inverse_actions JSON NOT NULL, 
	affected_entry_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	selection_snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	is_applied BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

entry_groups.sql:
CREATE TABLE entry_groups (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	parent_id VARCHAR(36), 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES entry_groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

job_events.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	stream VARCHAR(16), 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	data JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (job_id, sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

job_inputs.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_inputs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	entry_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	entry_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	structure_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (job_id, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

job_result_artifacts.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_result_artifacts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	importable_structure BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	imported_entry_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(artifact_id) REFERENCES artifacts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

jobs.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	plugin_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	job_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	implementation_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	parameters JSON NOT NULL, 
	progress FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	status_message VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	result_values JSON NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSON NOT NULL, 
	error JSON, 
	provenance JSON NOT NULL, 
	cancellation_requested BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	event_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(120), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

measurements.sql:

	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,

	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	atom_references JSON NOT NULL, 
	visible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
